import FreeCADGui
from PySide import QtCore
from freecad_buddy.usecases import script_exec as se
NAME = doc.Name
class _Probe:
    def GetResources(self):
        return {"MenuText": "FCB guard probe"}
    def IsActive(self):
        return True
    def Activated(self):
        d = FreeCAD.getDocument(NAME)
        rec = {"guarded_active_before": FreeCAD.getActiveTransaction()}
        env = se._run_bracket("probe", d, "doc.getObject('Box').Width = 17", True)
        sc = env["structured_content"]
        rec.update(status=env["status"], undo_steps=sc["undo_steps"], changed=sc["changed"], text=env["text"],
                   active_inside_after_bracket=FreeCAD.getActiveTransaction(), undo_names_inside=list(d.UndoNames))
        d.getObject('Box').Height = 21
        rec["undo_names_after_second_write_inside"] = list(d.UndoNames)
        FreeCAD._fcb_probe = rec
def _fire():
    FreeCADGui.runCommand("FCB_GuardProbe")
    d = FreeCAD.getDocument(NAME)
    FreeCAD._fcb_probe["active_after_command"] = FreeCAD.getActiveTransaction()
    FreeCAD._fcb_probe["undo_names_after_command"] = list(d.UndoNames)
FreeCADGui.addCommand("FCB_GuardProbe", _Probe())
QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(1500, _fire)
result = "registered"
